requirements: A feature grid composed of internal sub-components in the same package: a FeatureGrid that lays out a heading and a responsive grid of FeatureCard items (icon mark as an inline SVG, title, description). Editable fields: heading (text), columns (radio: 2, 3, 4), cardStyle (select: plain, outlined). No dependencies beyond react and @puckeditor/core, no remote resources.
